description: Held-out Summitline prompts used by src/compare_base_vs_finetuned.py (Exercise 7). None of these appear in gear_recommendations.jsonl — that is critical for the comparison to be meaningful.
prompts: I want to try dawn-patrol splitboarding around Bend — what should my kit look like?
Someone in my group is new to trad and wants a starter cam set under $600.
Weather looks iffy in Portland tomorrow — should I pack the softshell or the hardshell?
I need 6 headlamps for a scout troop leaving Friday.
Do you carry any climbing shoes stiff enough for edging on granite?
What's the smallest sleeping bag you have that still handles 20 F nights?
I keep forgetting my water — recommend an insulated bottle I can toss in the pack.
Doing a family-of-4 Yosemite trip in July — bear canister and 4P tent recs?
It'll be 55 F and raining in Seattle Saturday — running shoes for a wet trail?
I'm outfitting a new gym climber head-to-toe: harness, belay, rope, chalk. Budget $400.
Any climbing helmets that pair well with the Vertic rope?
What total am I looking at for 3 Aurora 20 bags plus 3 Aurora insulated pads?
